summary: Iteration 4 verifies the three fixes requested + regression. All three PASS. (1) MUSIC GATING: Hooked HTMLMediaElement.prototype.play/pause from an init script to log every playback. On main menu after intro: 13 'create' events (mp3 + wav preload) but ZERO 'play' events — music is NOT started on menu. Pressing OYNA fires a single [AUDIO_PLAY] on invincible.mp3 at t+4.8s. Escape (pause) fires 2 pause events (both crossfade players). pause-home-button fires 2 more pause events. Opening Settings from the menu fires a PLAY event (preview). Closing Settings fires 4 pause events and URL returns to '/'. Verified for the default invincible.mp3 track. (2) 404 SELF-HEAL: Pre-seeded localStorage player_id='"000000000000000000000000"', friend_code='"ZZZZZZ"', nickname='"TEST_SelfHeal"', deep-linked to /leaderboard, tapped Arkadaşlar. One 404 appears in the network log (friends GET on the bogus id) but [data-testid=leaderboard-error] is NEVER shown; recoverOnline() silently creates a new player (id=6ad26ab86364c44cbb69827f, friend_code=EEWBUL) and the friends board loads showing 'TEST_SelfHeal (sen) · 0 koşu · 0 altın' at rank 1. localStorage player_id/friend_code were updated in place. POST /api/players/{new_id}/runs {score:1234,coins:5} returns 200 with runs=1,high_score=1234 — runs submission works after self-heal. (3) DEEP-LINK BACK: Direct URL load of /leaderboard -> leaderboard-back-button -> URL becomes '/', menu-play-button visible (replace fallback). Direct URL load of /settings -> settings-close-button -> URL becomes '/', menu-play-button visible. No stuck state. (4) Regression: 17/17 backend pytest pass (test_api.py 16 + test_soft_delete.py 1 in 2.97s). Main menu renders cleanly (ISTANBUL RUNNER + OYNA + Koşucu nick + leaderboard/settings pills). HUD renders during gameplay (score counter). No deprecated expo packages detected (expo-audio in use; no expo-av). No React Native red-screen errors. textShadow* deprecation warning present (pre-existing cosmetic).

critical_code_review_comments: app/index.tsx:46-53 — audio.init() still runs on menu; this just creates AudioPlayer instances (prefetch) without calling play, which matches the spec ('fine if prefetched'). Verified empirically: 13 Audio() create events but 0 play events on menu.

app/index.tsx:123-135 — useFocusEffect pauses music whenever the screen gains focus if we are not in 'playing' mode, and pauses + sets paused state when losing focus during a run. Correctly stops menu music after returning from Settings/Leaderboard.
app/settings.tsx:25-28 — track-preview useEffect depends on [profile.music, profile.musicTrack]; cleanup calls audio.pauseMusic(). Preview stops on close. ✓
app/settings.tsx:30 and app/leaderboard.tsx:67 — both now use `router.canGoBack() ? router.back() : router.replace('/')`. Deep-link stranding fixed. ✓

src/profile.tsx:151-159 — recoverOnline() removes stored id/friend_code, resets state, calls ensureOnline() (which creates a new player), and best-effort submits the carry-over bestScore. src/profile.tsx:178-180 also recovers on 404 during submitRun. Robust. ✓
src/audio.ts:174-181 — pauseMusic() clears wantPlaying and pauses BOTH crossfade players (observed as 2 pause events in the hook log). ✓

context_for_next_testing_agent: To verify music gating on web, use page.add_init_script to monkey-patch HTMLMediaElement.prototype.play/pause and window.Audio before navigation — expo-audio on web renders as plain HTMLAudioElement, so this cleanly captures every music/sfx event. Playwright itself cannot verify audible output but the play/pause call sequence is deterministic and sufficient. The crossfade implementation calls pause on BOTH players so expect 2 pause events per pauseMusic() invocation. To test the 404 self-heal reliably, pre-seed localStorage via add_init_script (keys: player_id, friend_code, nickname — all JSON-stringified), then deep-link to /leaderboard and tap the Arkadaşlar tab; recoverOnline runs via a useEffect that watches friendsQ.error. The friend-code box text concatenates label and code (e.g. 'ARKADAŞ KODUEEWBUL').
